tool.name: Merge.taxsummary
tool.command:
@SHELL_OPTIONS@
## create symlinks to input datasets #for $i in $input: ln -s '$i' input${input.index($i)}.dat && #end for
## collect the arguments of the mothur command in a list and join them with ## commas, so that the command can never end with a trailing comma #set $mothur_args = [] #set $mothur_arg = "input=" #for $i in $input: #set $mothur_arg += "input" + str($input.index($i)) + ".dat-" #end for #silent $mothur_args.append($mothur_arg) #silent $mothur_args.append("output=" + str($output))
echo 'merge.taxsummary(${",".join($mothur_args)})' | sed 's/-,/,/g' | mothur | tee mothur.out.log
tool.help:
@MOTHUR_OVERVIEW@
.. _Mothur: https://mothur.org/wiki/
**Command Documentation**
The merge.taxsummary command merges the tax.summary datasets given as input into one ``merged tax.summary`` dataset.
.. _merge.taxsummary: https://mothur.org/wiki/merge.taxsummary/
